parent.R53_result: G4/G5/G7 PASS, 9856/9856 decisions cross-OS, synthetic DEV PASS 2/2, fixed stability heuristic ties learned, Native backbone zero contribution

hypothesis.primary: A frozen R53 learned reliability model may overfit oscillatory distractor variance: if the larger-contrast high-tag distractors become equally stable across repeated selected interventions, the learned variance-weighting rule can select their action consequences instead of truly gate-dependent causal responses.
hypothesis.control: Independent oscillating-distractor salt tests whether R53 learned policy retains normal synthetic OOD behavior on novel source positions with the same underlying mechanism.
hypothesis.falsifier: Both original R53 seeds must meet fixed new OOD regret and gate-flip thresholds in BOTH independent salts without any R54 OOD adaptation. Any failure is a cold transfer NO-GO; do not tune or relabel as learned causality.
hypothesis.source_positive_reference: A deliberately hand-coded observable public-tag reference takes the two actually observed tags in [.175,.185] and [.415,.425], independently of hidden source positions, then resolves context role using selected sixth-record contrasts and FIT-only selected fifth. This is a weak source-specific feasibility oracle, NOT a learned model or independent intelligence control.
hypothesis.independent_science: Even a passing result cannot establish general causal intelligence: baselines must be fully converged, input/compute matched, and new real environments independently qualified; Native backbone attribution must be positive.

source.remainder_nuisance: Public low tags .03 or zero; action invariant selected physical offset round(.014*sin((salt+group)*.137+source*.271)+.004*((source+group)%4-1.5),8). Zero action contrast.
source.placement: SHA256(R54/panel/salt/group/source) determines 4 distinct cue/decoy/spurious source positions. No private source ID or salt enters policy input.
source.record_format: For every source and each repeat, record actually selected action0 and action1 consequence from the same reset public tag state via original _record; zero effect[4] for B only. Preserve all 4 original selected early and selected fifth probe facts; masked preaction return. 16 physical channels exact original encoder.
source.evaluator: Use original R53 return physics, with fixed q×gate as evaluator-only labels, goal squared regret. Do not feed unselected return physical effects to policy.
source.opposite_gate_mean: Opposite hidden gates have identical action keys and full 16D public B mean, but distinct selected cue/decoy action consequence observations. Reject non-zero mean leak >1e-7.

original_replay.train_source: Only the original R53 FIT generator and unchanged draw seed 22749999; 384 selected factual return outcomes, 128 pairs for training, 64 FIT heldout.
original_replay.optimizer: Exactly R53 original AdamW per parameter lr, weight decay0, clip 1; no new hyperparameters or random seeds.

frozen_decision.if_fail: Report frozen cold transfer NO-GO, preserve the original R53 synthetic DEV PASS as distribution-specific, no source retuning nor updates on scored episodes.
frozen_decision.if_pass: Report two-new-source synthetic cold transfer only, no independent scientific validation without new environments and strong competency/compute-matched baselines.
